title: GAIA-2.0 Agent Validation Result
description: Schema for agent-validation.json produced by scripts/agent-validate.sh. Every field is mandatory. Consumers MUST reject results whose head_sha does not match the current repository HEAD before proposing any repair.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Increment when fields are added or removed.

head_sha.description: Full or abbreviated git SHA of HEAD at the time validation ran. Consumers MUST verify this matches the target commit before trusting the result.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the validation run started.

mode.description: Validation mode. 'full' runs every CI stage. 'changed' skips cli-integration and markdown. 'targeted' runs cargo-check and rust-workspace only.

status.description: Aggregate result. 'passed' only when every stage in the run passed.

failed_stage.description: Name of the first stage that failed, or null if status is 'passed'.

attempt.description: Correction attempt number for this task. Maximum 3 per task; the loop MUST stop and escalate if this reaches 3 without passing.

stages.description: Ordered list of stages that ran in this validation.

name.description: Stage identifier matching a CI job name.

diagnostics.description: Structured compiler/tool diagnostics extracted from cargo check --message-format=json. Empty array when status is 'passed'.

code.description: Rust error/warning code, e.g. E0277. Empty string when not applicable.

path.description: file:line location of the primary span.

fingerprint.description: Stable identifier code:file:line used to detect repeated failures without meaningful progress.
